text:
This bead's existing acceptance criteria need rewriting before it can be claimed autonomously. They were written under Architecture 1 ("Rust struct IS OSCAL"). PKIX-9vnx.2's closing notes (and PKIX-ztmr's Arch 2 note) establish that Architecture 2 is what's actually being built: pkix-lint's internal Rust types stay lean and tailored to lint work, and thin serializer/parser modules emit OSCAL Assessment Results JSON. No pkix-oscal Rust crate, no roscal_lib dep, no schema-generated binding.

Under Arch 2, this bead should be re-cast as:

(a) Define an OSCAL Assessment Results serializer module in pkix-lint (e.g., src/oscal_ar.rs) that emits `serde_json::Value` from an existing EvaluationReport.
(b) The Rust EvaluationReport type stays as-is or gets minor field additions only as needed by the serializer (e.g., a generated UUID, an evaluation-start timestamp). It does NOT get reshaped to mirror OSCAL field names.
(c) Round-trip the emitted JSON against NIST's OSCAL Assessment Results JSON Schema (out-of-process via oscal-cli, or a CI fixture comparing against a checked-in golden JSON).

Acceptance criteria as written ("EvaluationReport Rust type has fields named per OSCAL conventions") directly contradict Arch 2. Asking the maintainer to (i) rewrite the bead under the Arch 2 framing, or (ii) ratify the (a)-(c) recasting above so I can take it next session. Recommend (ii) — the recasting follows mechanically from PKIX-ztmr's closing note ".3-.7 reframe from 'realign Rust types TO OSCAL' to 'add OSCAL serializer/parser for these types.'"

Labeling human and moving on.
